message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, the number of heads you can obtain ranges from **0** to **3** inclusive.

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | \( \frac{1}{8}\) (12.5 %) |
| 1     | \( \frac{3}{8}\) (37.5 %) |
| 2     | \( \frac{3}{8}\) (37.5 %) |
| 3     | \( \frac{1}{8}\) (12.5 %) |

The expected (average) number of heads per toss of three coins is  
\(E[X] = np = 3 \times \tfrac12 = 1.5\).
